text: Memeza is the thirteenth studio album by South African singer Brenda Fassie, released on 3 November 1998, which coincided with her birthday. It became the best-selling album in South Africa during 1998. The album achieved Platinum status on the day of its release and sold over 100,000 copies within its first week. It eventually sold 700,000 copies in South Africa. Originally released in 1997 by CCP Records in physical format, the album was re-released in digital form by EMI Digital in 2004. The music is primarily categorized as pop/rock and Kwaito, a South African urban music style. The album's themes explore topics such as tradition and marriage. Sello Twala and Brenda Fassie co-wrote all the songs, with Twala responsible for the production.
